name: As Samad
description: Allah is wholly self-sufficient, needing nothing. All creation depends on Him and turns to Him for the fulfilment of its needs.
summary: As Samad is the One to whom all creation turns in need, while He Himself needs nothing. In explanations of Quran 112:2, this includes complete self-sufficiency and perfect lordship. The Eternal Refuge is a short label for this meaning, not merely a claim about enduring forever.
